meta_title: G&G Professional Services | Painter & Decorator Birmingham
meta_description: G&G Professional Services is a trusted painter and decorator in Birmingham. Expert interior and exterior work, competitive rates, free quotes. Call today.
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert decorating. From fresh walls to complete room makeovers in Smethwick and across Birmingham.
services_subhead: We handle every decorating project, from single-room updates to full commercial refurbishments with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Decorating
services.desc: Complete wall and ceiling decoration for living spaces, kitchens, and bedrooms. We prepare, prime, and paint to a finish that lasts.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior work on fascias, soffits, and masonry. Protects your home and boosts kerb appeal for years.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Expert hanging of all wallpaper types, from traditional to modern. Perfectly aligned seams and a professional finish every time.

services.title: Woodwork & Glazing
services.desc: Professional painting of doors, windows, skirting boards, and fitted furniture. Durable finishes that resist wear and weather.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Office, retail, and hospitality spaces redecorated to your brand standards. Minimal downtime, maximum professionalism.

services.title: Preparation & Repairs
services.desc: Thorough surface prep, crack filling, and repairs before any paint touches your walls. A solid base means a flawless finish.

about_pullquote: Good decorating starts with proper preparation and honest pricing, no cutting corners.
about_para_1: G&G Professional Services has been transforming homes and businesses across Birmingham since 2012. We specialise in interior and exterior decorating, from small refresh projects to large commercial contracts. Every job is backed by our commitment to clean work, punctuality, and quality finishes that last.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen, we prepare properly, and we treat your home with the same care we'd give our own. We're fully insured, respectful of your space, and proud of the relationships we build with families and businesses across Smethwick and the wider Birmingham area.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About G&G

reviews.text: Had G&G paint our lounge and hallway. The preparation was brilliant—filled cracks, sanded everything smooth. The finish is flawless and they cleaned up after themselves. Fair price, quick job. Highly recommend them.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Needed urgent exterior work before winter. These lads got us in quickly, painted our fascia and soffits to a high standard. Professional team, no messing about. Will use them again when we redecorate inside.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Very impressed. They quoted us fairly, turned up on time, and completed the job in the timeframe promised. Really careful with furniture and floors. The wallpapering in our kitchen is perfect—not a bubble in sight.
reviews.author: James L.
